COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
28.03.2025
C528 no.392 of 2025
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. M.K. Goyal, Advocate for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. Deepak Bisht, Deputy A.G. with Mr. 
Devendra Singh, Brief Holder for the State.
3. This petition is filed for quashing of charge￾sheet dated 24.06.2024 and the summoning order 
dated 24.12.2024 passed by A.C.J.M., Dehradun in 
Criminal Case No.9599 of 2024 as well as the entire 
criminal proceedings emanating therefrom.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would 
submit that petitioner is mother-in-law of the 
respondent no.2/complainant; that, respondent 
no.2/complainant never lived in the matrimonial 
house with the petitioner; that, after marriage the
respondent no.2/complainant and her husband i.e. 
the son of petitioner were residing together in Abu 
Dhabi where some misunderstanding cropped up
between the two; that, the FIR was lodged on false 
and frivolous grounds; that, even if the allegations 
made in the FIR are taken to be true and accepted in 
entirety, the same do not constitute a prima facie
case against the petitioner. 
6. Issue notice to respondent no.2 through 
ordinary and registered post acknowledgment due as 
well as by Email and WhatsApp, if available.
7. Steps to be taken within two weeks.
8. List on 02.07.2025 for hearing on admission.
9. Till the next date of listing, further  proceedings of Criminal Case No.9599 of 2024 
“State vs. Abdul Rehman and another”, shall remain 
stayed qua the petitioner.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 
 28.03.2025
Rajni
